description: P14 genre-tagged static variety pools. The pre-P14 global blueprint pool constants (chapterBlueprint.ts) reorganized under genre keys, with each entry assigned to the genre it actually fits. `generic` is the neutral superset (the pre-P14 constants) used as the byte-compat legacy pool and the top-up source every other genre draws from to reach its floors. The investing document venues live under `investing` ONLY; the moments-flavored scene frames live under `experience-design`. Books map to a genre via config/genre-map (books.json category); a book without a design artifact and mapped to `generic` compiles byte-identically to the pre-P14 world. Blueprints remain deterministic: these are static config, not model output. Each genre also carries `reservedFigureNames`: invented protagonists must never be named after a SOURCE figure of that genre's canon (R-115 moved the investing block here out of src/compiler/sourceNames.ts, where it was applied to every book — including a memoir by Benjamin Franklin).
